test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Frankness
solution: The correct answer is '**Deception**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Frankness**' is '**Deception**'. • **Frankness**: the quality of being open, honest, and direct in speech or writing. (वाक्य की स्पष्टता) • *Example: Lisa spoke with disarming **frankness** about the accident.* • **Deception**: making somebody believe or being made to believe something that is not true. (धोखा देने की क्रिया) • *Example: He had obtained the secret papers by **deception**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Deception.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Transparency**: a piece of plastic on which you can write or draw or that has a picture, etc. on it that you look at by putting it on a special machine (projector) and shining light through it. [पारदर्शी प्‍लास्टिक खंड जिस पर कुछ लिखा हो, आरेख या चित्र बना हो (जिसे प्रोजेक्‍टर पर रोशनी डालकर देखा जा सके)] • **Openness**: the quality of being honest and ready to talk about your feelings. (मस्तिष्क और हृदय का खुलापन) • **Strangeness**: the state or fact of being strange. (विचित्रता) 1b1:T518, The correct answer is **'To express openly'.**
